custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Part Library & Inventory — View and no Vendor Order Management permission, so user B can see parts but not vendor orders.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use a second browser window (a private window) signed in as user B.
  • Write down the address of the Returns list: as the Admin, open Parts, then Returns, and copy the address from the browser's address bar.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573685-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573685-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • Settings: click the box at the top right, then Settings in its menu. The left menu then lists Staff, Roles & Permissions, Bin Locations and Categories, and Inventory under IMPORTS.
  • To create a custom role: Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu, then Create Custom Role; in Choose a template click Skip; type the Role Name; switch on Parts Department, then tick the boxes the setup names on its three rows, Part sales, Part Library and Inventory, and Vendor and order management (each has View, Create & Edit and Delete); See Financial Data is under Cross-Cutting Toggles; then click Create. (The setup above writes these boxes as, for example, Part Library & Inventory — View, which is the View box on the Part Library and Inventory row.)
  • User B: the QA site's sign-in screen offers only Admin and Tech, so user B is the shared Tech sign-in given role B for this test. Signed in as Admin: Settings, then Staff in the left menu; click Search, type tech@shopview.com, click the edit icon at the end of Tech ShopView's row, pick role B under Role and click Save & Close. Then, in the second (private) window, choose Tech on the sign-in screen. When the test is finished, set Tech ShopView's Role back to Technician the same way, because other testers use that sign-in.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Parts left menu opens for user B with Inventory in it, and it does not offer Returns.

Step 2:

  • The address is typed.

Step 3:

  • The Returns list does not open for user B: no list of returns and no Create Return button are shown.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work), story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library)

  • S9-N3a: “Opening Parts → Returns and starting a vendor return keep the access today's 'Vendor Order Management' settings give. This feature adds, removes and changes no permission (S12-N1). 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit' carries part search access, so a role with it can search for parts on a return even though its 'Part Library & Inventory → View' box is not ticked. No on-screen route reaches S9-N3, because every role that can start a return has part search access; the access error shows only when the Create Return page is opened by its address, by a role with 'Vendor Order Management → View' and no setting that carries part search access.”
  • S12-N1: “No permission is added, removed or re-keyed. Every user's access on release day is identical to the day before.”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 22: “(a) No. Without Vendor Order Management, Parts → Returns is hidden and refused.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
